note: G1 capability bundles — named sets of capability flags resolved server-side by console/capabilities.mjs. The admin/lead/builder defaults reproduce the pre-refactor role behavior exactly (zero behavior change). Editable via the admin bundles API; domainOverrides may add/remove flags per bundle inside one domain.

admin.description: Platform team: governance, vending, approvals, integrations. Content planes stay domain-owned — platform-side content access is break-glass only.

lead.description: Domain lead: everything a builder has, plus deciding access requests and default (audited) visibility of the owned domain's content plane.

builder.description: Domain builder: build/deploy agents in the own domain, request content access through the grant path.

user.description: End user: chat with published agents only. No operator, builder, or governance surfaces.
